import numpy as np, math, collections, importlib.util
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689824/attempts/9d615e3a66d9447e8803eb583e82b2e3/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''from collections import Counter
from math import gcd
from functools import reduce

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    structural = {c for c, _ in counts.most_common(2)}
    marks = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in structural]
    if not marks:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    ys = sorted({r for r, c in marks})
    xs = sorted({c for r, c in marks})
    dy = reduce(gcd, (b-a for a, b in zip(ys, ys[1:])), 0) if len(ys)>1 else 1
    dx = reduce(gcd, (b-a for a, b in zip(xs, xs[1:])), 0) if len(xs)>1 else 1
    dy = max(dy, 1); dx = max(dx, 1)
    rows = list(range(ys[0], ys[-1]+1, dy))
    cols = list(range(xs[0], xs[-1]+1, dx))
    fill = grid[1][1] if h > 1 and w > 1 else min(structural)
    out = [[fill for _ in range(len(cols)-1)] for _ in range(len(rows)-1)]
    for i in range(len(rows)-1):
        for j in range(len(cols)-1):
            vals = [grid[rows[i]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i]][cols[j+1]], grid[rows[i+1]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i+1]][cols[j+1]]]
            if vals[0] == vals[1] == vals[2] == vals[3] and vals[0] not in structural:
                out[i][j] = vals[0]
    return out
'''
